subject: reasoning
question: J, K, L, M, N, O and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between O and J when counted from the left of O. Only three people sit between K and M when counted from the right of M. S sits to the immediate right of K. N is an immediate neighbour of M as well as J. Who sits second to the left of L?
solution:
Given: J, K, L, M, N, O and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1) Only three people sit between O and J when counted from the left of O.

2) Only three people sit between K and M when counted from the right of M.

3) S sits to the immediate right of K. 

4) N is an immediate neighbour of M as well as J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20cee1ae0edef441e3bc0a434133073ea8f0516d7d2d34a6d68c936df7e52260.png] 

Here, **N** sits second to the left of L

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
